msg: keep your fingers over S and K plus the space bar. I was advised that the green and purple gnomes have one basket and the brown and red gnomes have the other. So I advise stick with one pair until the mushrooms drop below 5 then switch to the other pair. This seemed to produces long runs of high scores. The red and purple gnomes look similar though so be careful and press quick as you really have little time. Good Luck!
